title: finding(pm): `dispatch-gates.mjs` derives gates only for its own tree, so objectui-lane dispatches hand-derive their gate list, and this shift's list missed the CI `Type Check` pre-tsc battery
body:
Handoff-report item from the `domain:ui` seat 2 sign-off (objectstack-ai/objectui#9771), category **mechanizable**. Filed with `finding` only: `lanes/ui.md` says this seat writes no `domain:*`, type or grade, so routing to the skills lane is triage's call.

## What happened

This seat's dispatches to objectui used a gate list derived by hand. The list left out the checks that objectui's CI `Type Check` job runs before tsc (`check:spec-symbols`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, …). As a result, objectstack-ai/objectui#12317 went red on `check:spec-symbols` and needed one patch round. The seat-post notes now say to include that battery, but that is prose, not a mechanism.

## Measured

- `dispatch-gates.mjs` takes its tree from its own location: `ROOT` comes from `import.meta.url`.
- Its own header says `--repo` refuses unless the checkout is that repo.
- Run from an objectstack snapshot with `--repo objectstack-ai/objectui` and an objectui path, it refused ("cannot verify --repo 'objectstack-ai/objectui'") and reported the path as absent from its tree.
- objectui has no copy of the tool. `git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main | grep -i dispatch-gates` returns 0 hits on objectui `866763b`.

So no tool derives an objectui gate list today, and every objectui-lane dispatch relies on a hand-written one.

## Dedupe

- objectstack `search_issues` for "dispatch gate list objectui Type Check pre-tsc check:spec-symbols omitted hand-derived dispatch-gates": 0 hits.
- objectstack `search_issues` for "dispatch-gates cannot derive gate list for objectui checkout sister repo tree ROOT": 72 hits. The nearest is objectstack-ai/objectstack#18383 (absent-path ambiguity, closed). None covers deriving gates for a sister repo.
